summary: I help families set up LegalShield and IDShield, from PPLSI, so they have legal and identity protection in place before they need it, and aren't figuring it out alone when a legal question or an identity problem comes up.
audience: Families. New parents who keep meaning to do a will, grown children looking out for their parents, people moving into a new home or lease, and people doing gig or 1099 work who sign their own contracts. I can go over it in English or Vietnamese.
problem:
Before: "My mom almost sent them money." "I can't afford a lawyer for every little thing." "We really need to do a will." Something goes wrong and they're not sure who they'd call. Most people only look at this after a scare.
After: when a strange letter or a legal question shows up, they already know where to take it.
moments:
A new baby, and the will they keep meaning to do
A fake call "from the bank" or "from the IRS" that shook Mom or Dad
A data breach letter in the mail
A new home or lease with small print nobody explained
Gig or 1099 work, signing contracts with no one to ask
offerings:
LegalShield membership, from PPLSI: legal protection for the household
IDShield membership, from PPLSI: identity protection for you and your family
Help in English or Vietnamese, including going over it with your parents in Vietnamese before the call
howItRuns:
It's a paid membership with an ongoing cost, not a class. I can go over it in English or Vietnamese. What a membership includes for a family is a question for the free call.
The free call is 15 minutes with the NowTRANSFORMED team, any time in the next three weeks, and a lunch break works. Spouses and parents are welcome to join. After the call, the family talks it over at home, and if it fits, they set up the membership.
faqs:
Q: How much does it cost?
A: It's a paid membership and an ongoing cost, so it has to be worth it to you. You'll get the exact price on your free call.

Q: My bank already gives me identity protection.
A: Good, you're ahead of most people. Bring what you have to the call and ask. If it already covers you, keep it.

Q: Can my spouse or my parents join?
A: Yes. Couples often decide this together, so bring your husband or wife and hear it once. If your parents are more comfortable in Vietnamese, I can go over it with them before the call.

Q: How do I know this is legitimate?
A: Smart to check. LegalShield and IDShield come from PPLSI, and you can look them up yourself. And never send anyone your Social Security number or account numbers by text or email, me included.

Q: Is this one of those pyramid things?
A: LegalShield has a separate business side, where people sign up as independent associates. This call is only about protection for your family.
aboutYou:
I'm a father of three and an entrepreneur. My background spans engineering and dentistry, and I spent over 20 years in technology, with roles at Apple, Microsoft and Intel.

I'm a licensed tax preparer, and my work in legal and financial protection includes PPLSI (LegalShield) and 101 Financial. I'm also Regional Director of Oregon and Director of Communications at NowTRANSFORMED.

I'm fluent in Vietnamese and I believe in families helping families. My motto: "Success is We NOT Me."
mustNotSay:
No prices on the page.
No legal, tax or financial advice. What a membership covers is a question for the free call.
Never promise a legal outcome, or that IDShield will stop every scam or identity theft.
Keep the LegalShield business side (independent associates) out of it. This is about protection for families.
